So one day I decided that I was going to be brave and try false lashes. That day came in my 64th year. I struggled with putting them on so much! reviews.t: Very quick, beautiful lashes! Look natural.
reviews.x: These lashes were packaged beautifully. They look expensive, natural and were so easy to use. I frequently wear lashes, but hate the glue and most adhesive lash options don’t stick. These use your body heat to adhere. As long as you have cleaned the area and there is no makeup on, they will go on very easy. My only complaint is they do not come with a wand/grabber to help you with attaching the lashes. I used one that I’ve had which made application really easy and ensure I don’t touch the adhes

I ordered these not expecting much. I have a terrible time trying to use the ones with glue, I’ve even tried the magnetic, but,  I can never get them to feel or look normal. These were easy! This is the 2nd day same pair. I’m really pleased with the purchase and will definitely order again. I shared with my daughter and she’s ordering also. I highly recommend.

It will take practice for me. But they did stick on and come off without hurting my natural eyelashes. After several tries with one, it did lose its stickiness, but the instructions say to wet it and warm it with a hairdryer. So I’m sure that will make them work. Wore this to my holiday party last week and loved them! My husband didn't even realize I had fake lashes on. I don't like buying lashes since they're wasteful and hard to use. These lashes solve for both issues. Love that I can reuse. I've seen the magnetic lashes but they look a bit obvious (from the packaging, as I've never used) and I imagine they're heavy. These lashes are also sooo easy to use. I heated them with my hairdryer and they were on in a pinch and stayed on the entire night. Highl

I'm terrible with putting on fake lashes. These were the easiest I've ever used and they stayed put for more than a day. They were a little much for me in terms of glam, but others might like that. I'm in my early 60's. Great product!

Most false lashes look...false.  These lashes are so natural looking!  I normally am so nervous when wearing false lashes that they will fall off but the adhesive on these lashes is amazing and lasted all day!
These last all day and are easy to get in and off I bought them for a wedding. In the pix I have one eye with the lashes on and one eye without to show the difference. Makes eyes nice and big for pix

These lashes are very easy to use. You may need to get used to the difference between these and glue on lashes but these are easier & less messy. Also, they are much less damaging than individual glue on lashes which tend to cause loss & breakage of natural lashes. They give a natural to exotic look, depending on which lashes you wear. No liner needed. They are as described & I highly recommend them.

[[VIDEOID:c532bce9e54b5b455ea0be2a24a66fcf]] Nice lashes! I like the shortest ones best for an everyday look. The strip itself is thick which is nice cuz it's reusable, after the glue get tacky with old gunk you can remove it and put regular eyelash glue. Really like them!
[[VIDEOID:ae2382234e9a3a585768852dc3894d86]] I don’t have anything that I dislike. My plans are to try them on January 8th for church.

reviews.t: Be patient and learn how to apply
reviews.x: After years of wearing false eyelashes, I became allergic to glues.  These new "pre-glued" eyelashes has allowed me to wear "falsies" once again.  I love them.  I can see where a "newby" may become frustrated with application.  You MUST handle slowly and carefully.  Use tweasers to remover from application and apply with care.  They are wonderful.

reviews.t: Perfect Lashes and easy to apply
reviews.x: These eyelashes are perfect!! Especially for us that don't wear makeup daily.  Putting these lashes on is easy and quick,  especially  for me since I have difficulty apply liner neatly. These lashes are great for everyday to make you feel beautiful without a lot of fuss. The adhesion is good and they are a great value

I wore these for a night out and they were the perfect touch. They were easy to apply and lasted the entire night. The variety pack was perfect if you wanted to go glam or keep it modest. Definitely will buy again!

I’ve worn fake lashes for a while, messing with adhesives and glue. These are super easy to apply and they last all day. (I don’t sleep with them since they get funky looking in the morning.) The reusable adhesive for me lasted 4-5 days. (Washing as directed) I liked the fact the four different styles of lashes were included. I was able to see which ones I liked the best. Next time I’ll just order the pair I liked the most rather than an assortment.

It looks like there are only 2 pairs, a top and a bottom.  However come to find out that each cell contained both the upper and lower lash.  It’s certainly not obvious when taking them off each cell (packaging).  So I thought I only got 2 pair and had much difficulty removing them from the packaging without them being stretched cause the self-adhesive makes it almost impossible to remove them.
I'm a novice at applying lashes but these self adhesive lashes made the steps simple and without any complications...I'll be buying more of these!

I have been buying different eyelashes to see which ones works best and saves time during installation. I figure these would be great, but I was disappointed. The adhesive on the ends did not stick to my eyebrows. My lids were dry and clean. The instructions say to press for 2 minutes. I did exactly that but had zero success. Both eyelashes failed to stick. I didn’t bother with another pair. After thirty minutes of trying, I moved on to different eyelashes. I will not buy this product again.

I really wanted to love these eyelashes when I got them. The first pair that I removed there was no adhesive on one of the eyelashes I am unsure if it came off when I was removing the eyelashes from the case or if it was just like that, I tried putting on the second pair and I had to use eyelash glue to the corners so they would not come off. Even though I had to use eyelash glue they looked really amazing on.

I was skeptical of this product, but for the price decided to give it a try. So glad I did! Very easy to use, they lashes are very comfortable, there are different styles to choose depending on the occasion, you can trim them to fit your eyes and the price is so reasonable. Definitely recommending this lashes, no more glue, or magnetic liner for me.

I wore these self adhesive leashes on a 5 day cruise to the Bahamas and even with sweating and the humidity they held on all day and were reusable the next day! Easiest lashes to apply! Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Don't waste your time or money
reviews.x: Impossible to line up.  Does NOT adhere well.  Total waste of time and money

reviews.t: Works, really well. I like the different sets
reviews.x: I like these are self adhesive and they stay on really well

I’ve been using these eyelashes for a few months and I really like them. They are super easy to put on and they do stay in place completely for the first use and mostly for the second. I don’t use them again after that but I love the look they provide. I wish I could order them in bulk!  By the way I’m Jeremy’s wife leaving the review 😉

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to apply, especially compared to glue-on options.
Many reviewers say the lashes look natural.
Reviewers report the lashes stay on well and last all day.
Some reviewers note a learning curve or difficulty with placement, particularly for beginners.
Reviewers appreciate that the lashes are reusable.
